items.summary: アメリカのトランプ大統領は日本時間の13日朝早く、中国に向け出発しました。14日、習近平国家主席との首脳会談に臨む予定で、経済・貿易面での課題や、台湾をめぐる問題、それにイラン情勢について、どのような…

items.title: 米中首脳会談を前にイランがけん制 “中国とは強固な関係”
items.title_zh: 在美中峰会前的伊朗"同中国的牢固关系".

items.title: 国連 ケニアで大会議場の起工式 第3拠点として機能移転進む
items.title_zh: 大型会堂施工典礼第3名

items.summary_zh: 11日,联合国有一个大型会议室,为联合国大会开幕.

items.title: How the Trump-Xi summit could set superpower relations for many years to come
items.title_zh: 特朗普-习近平峰会如何在未来多年建立超级大国关系.

items.summary_zh: 北京历史天安门广场周边的安保被提升了好几天,社交媒体上传出"特大游行"或"搞出一些"花花公子"的大事件"等谣言.

items.title: 磐越道部活バス事故 4月から約1か月で少なくとも5件の物損事故

items.summary: 今月6日、福島県の磐越自動車道で、部活動の遠征でマイクロバスに乗っていた新潟県の高校生など21人が死傷した事故で、バスを運転していた68歳の容疑者は、先月から1か月ほどの間に少なくとも5件の物損事故を…
items.summary_zh: 本月6日, 21名高中生在福岛市的岩手高速公路上骑着一辆微型巴士死亡。

items.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
items.title_zh: 黎巴嫩说,在以色列袭击中死亡的13人中有两名医护人员。
items.summary: Israeli air strikes have killed at least 13 people in southern Lebanon, state media say, where a ceasefire has failed to stop the war between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.
items.summary_zh: 以色列空袭造成黎巴嫩南部至少13人死亡,

items.title: US inflation jumps to 3.8% as energy costs surge from Iran war
items.title_zh: 随着伊朗战争的能源成本飙升,美国通货膨胀跃升到3.8%
items.summary: US prices rose in April at their fastest rate since May 2023 as the impact of the war in Iran was increasingly felt by consumers.
items.summary_zh: 随着消费者日益感受到伊朗战争的影响,美国价格在4月以自2023年5月以来最快的速度上涨.

items.title: Dali ship operator charged over deadly Baltimore bridge collapse
items.title_zh: 达利轮船运营商对巴尔的摩桥倒塌事件提出指控
items.summary: Federal prosecutors have filed criminal charges against the owner of the cargo ship Dali, two years after the vessel struck Baltimore's Key Bridge, causing its collapse and killing six people.
items.summary_zh: 联邦检察官对货轮"达利"号船主提出刑事指控,这是该船撞倒巴尔的摩克桥两年后,导致其倒塌并造成6人死亡.

items.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
items.title_zh: 联合国卫生机构表示,
items.summary: There is "no sign" of a larger hantavirus outbreak after the evacuation of the last passengers from a disease-stricken cruise ship, the head of the UN health agency has said.
items.summary_zh: 联合国卫生机构负责人说,在从一艘疾病严重的游轮上撤离最后一批乘客后,没有出现更大的汉塔病毒爆发的"迹象".

items.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
items.title_zh: 以色列调查说,
items.summary: An independent, Israeli investigation has published harrowing details of "systematic, widespread" sexual violence by Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups during the attacks on 7 October 2023, and against hostages.
items.summary_zh: 以色列的一项独立调查公布了哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装团体在2023年10月7日的袭击中实施的"系统而广泛的"性暴力以及针对人质的令人痛心的细节.

items.title: South Africa's top court bars repeat asylum applications
items.title_zh: 南非的最高法院禁止重复庇护申请
items.summary: South Africa's highest court has ruled that foreign nationals cannot reapply for asylum once their application has been rejected.
items.summary_zh: 南非最高法院裁定,外国国民的申请一旦被拒绝,就不能重新申请庇护。

items.title: Zelensky's ex-chief of staff in court as Ukraine corruption probe escalates
items.title_zh: Zelensky在乌克兰腐败调查升级时在法庭上担任前总参谋长
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky's former right-hand man Andriy Yermak appeared in a Kyiv court on Tuesday, after he was named by Ukraine's two anti-corruption agencies as a suspect in a money-laundering scheme.
items.summary_zh: 沃洛德米尔·泽连斯基总统前右撇子安德里·耶尔马克(Andriy Yermak)于星期二在基辅法院出场,此前他被乌克兰的两个反腐败机构指为洗钱计划的嫌疑人.

items.title: Uganda's president sworn in for record seventh term
items.title_zh: 乌干达总统宣誓就职,
items.summary: Uganda's President Yoweri Museveni, 81, has been sworn in for a record seventh consecutive term following his landslide victory in disputed elections in January, extending his tenure as one of Africa's longest-serving rulers.
items.summary_zh: 乌干达总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼(81岁)在1月有争议的选举中获得滑坡胜利后,连续七届宣誓就职,延长了他作为非洲任职时间最长的统治者之一的任期。

items.title: eBay rejects $55.5bn offer from GameStop
items.title_zh: eBay 拒绝 GameStop的55.5bn 提议
items.summary: Online marketplace eBay has rejected a $55.5bn (£40.9bn) takeover offer from video game retailer GameStop, calling it "unsolicited" and "neither credible nor attractive".
items.summary_zh: 网络市场eBay拒绝了电子游戏零售商GameStop的55.5bn(40.9bn英镑)收购报价,称其为"不主动"和"既不可信也不吸引人".

items.title: US in closely guarded talks to open new bases in Greenland
items.title_zh: 美国在格陵兰开辟新基地的会谈中
items.summary: The US has been holding regular negotiations with Denmark to expand its military presence in Greenland, according to multiple officials familiar with the discussions, with talks between both sides progressing in recent months.
items.summary_zh: 据熟悉讨论的多位官员说,美国一直与丹麦定期谈判,以扩大其在格陵兰的军事存在,最近几个月双方的谈判正在取得进展。

items.title: France seeks to move beyond colonial ties by meeting African leaders in Kenya
items.title_zh: 法国在肯尼亚会见非洲领导人,试图超越殖民关系。
items.summary: Accused of neo-colonial meddling in many African countries where it has traditionally had close ties, France is broadening its horizons by co-hosting a summit of African leaders in English-speaking Kenya for the first time.
items.summary_zh: 法国被指控在传统上关系密切的许多非洲国家进行新殖民主义干涉,法国正在扩大视野,首次在肯尼亚英语地区共同主办非洲领导人首脑会议。

items.title: EU needs to delay social media access for children - von der Leyen
items.title_zh: 欧盟需要推迟儿童的社交媒体访问-冯德莱恩
items.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has proposed a "social media delay" for children in Europe and has said new legislation could be put forward in months.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯·德莱延(Ursula von der Leyen)曾提出欧洲儿童"社交媒体延迟",并表示几个月后可以提出新的立法.

items.title: Mexico cancels plans to end school year early for World Cup
items.title_zh: 墨西哥取消世界杯提前结束学年的计划
items.summary: The Mexican government has cancelled plans to end the school year more than a month early to ease traffic during the Fifa World Cup and an anticipated heatwave.
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥政府取消了提前一个多月结束学年的计划来缓解菲法世界杯期间的交通和预期的热浪.

items.title: Canvas hack: Company pays criminals to delete students' stolen data
items.title_zh: Canvas黑客:公司付钱给罪犯删除学生被窃取的数据
items.summary: The company behind the popular Canvas software, which was hacked last week causing major disruption at thousands of universities and colleges, has paid the hackers not to publish stolen data online.
items.summary_zh: 上星期被黑客入侵的Canvas软件在上千所大学和学院造成了重大干扰,该公司向黑客支付了不在网上发布被窃数据的费用。

items.title: Texas accuses Netflix of spying on users, including children
items.title_zh: 德克萨斯指控Netflix对包括儿童在内的用户进行间谍活动
items.summary: Netflix has been sued in Texas over claims it collects data belonging to children and adults in the US state without their consent, and uses "addictive" design to keep them hooked.
items.summary_zh: Netflix在德克萨斯州因未经儿童及成人同意而收集他们的数据而被起诉,

items.title: US passengers of hantavirus cruise ship being monitored in Nebraska
items.title_zh: 在内布拉斯加州监测汉塔病毒游轮的美国乘客
items.summary: Eighteen Americans evacuated from a cruise ship after possible exposure to hantavirus are being closely monitored by health officials at two of the country's top medical centres.
items.summary_zh: 18名美国人在可能接触汉塔病毒后从邮轮上撤离,他们正在该国两个顶级医疗中心接受卫生官员的密切监测。

items.title: China should stop hoarding food and fertiliser, says former World Bank chief
items.title_zh: 中国应该停止囤积食物和肥料,
items.summary: China should stop hoarding food and fertiliser to ease a global supply crisis caused by the Iran war, a former World Bank president has told the BBC.
items.summary_zh: 中国应该停止囤积粮食和肥料来缓解由伊朗战争所引发的全球供应危机,一位前世界银行行长已经告诉了英国广播公司.

items.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
items.title_zh: 当伊朗战争打倒了墨水供应,
items.summary: Japanese snack giant Calbee says it will temporarily switch to black and white packaging for some of its best-known products as supplies of an ingredient used in ink have been disrupted by the Iran war.
items.summary_zh: 日本小吃巨头Calbee表示,会暂时换成黑白包装,用于一些最出名的产品,因为用在墨水中的一种成分的供应被伊朗战争打乱了.

items.title: The Kabul rehab centre hit by deadly Pakistani strike
items.title_zh: 喀布尔康复中心遭到巴基斯坦致命袭击
items.summary: On 16 March 2026, at least 269 people were killed in a Pakistani airstrike on the Omid Drug Rehabilitation Hospital in Kabul, Afghanistan.
items.summary_zh: 2026年3月16日,巴基斯坦空袭阿富汗喀布尔奥米德戒毒所,造成至少269人死亡.

items.title: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦袭击了一个康复中心并杀害了269名阿富汗人。 他们的家人想知道为什么
items.summary: On a rainy, cold morning Masooda makes her way to a hillside cemetery in north-west Kabul to visit the grave of her younger brother Mirwais.
items.summary_zh: 在一阵雨中,寒冷的早晨Masooda赶去喀布尔西北部的一座山坡墓地去探望她弟弟Mirwais的坟墓.

items.title: Ex-Philippine leader Duterte's drug war enforcer escapes ICC arrest
items.title_zh: 前菲律賓領導人杜特特的毒品戰犯出逃了ICC的逮捕.
items.summary: A Filipino senator who oversaw former president Rodrigo Duterte's deadly war on drugs has taken refuge inside the country's Senate, hours before the International Criminal Court unsealed a warrant for his arrest.
items.summary_zh: 一名菲律宾参议员监督前总统罗德里戈·杜特特(Rodrigo Duterte)的致命毒品战争,

items.title: Israel passes law to allow death penalty and public trials for those linked to 7 October
items.title_zh: 以色列通过法律,允许对与10月7日有关的人判处死刑并进行公开审判
items.summary: Israel has passed a new law to impose the death penalty and conduct public trials for those involved in the unprecedented Hamas-led attacks and mass hostage-taking in Israel in October 2023.
items.summary_zh: 以色列已通过一项新法律,对参与2023年10月哈马斯所领导的前所未有的袭击和大规模劫持人质的人判处死刑并进行公开审判。

items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
items.title_zh: 特朗普说伊朗停火在"大规模生命支持".
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has said the month-long ceasefire between the US and Iran is on "massive life support".
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示,美伊长达一个月的停火正在"大规模地维持生命".

items.title: Why welfare isn't winning elections in India like it used to
items.title_zh: 为什么福利不能像过去那样在印度赢得选举
items.summary: India's welfare politics is not collapsing - but its electoral magic may be fading.
items.summary_zh: 印度的福利政治并没有崩溃,

items.title: I led hikers up an Indonesian volcano - and then it erupted
items.title_zh: 我带徒步者爬上印度尼西亚火山 然后火山喷出
items.summary: An Indonesian guide who led a group of hikers up Mount Dukono has described the harrowing moment they were caught up in Friday's eruption, which killed three people in his group.
items.summary_zh: 一位带领一群徒步者登上杜科诺山的印尼导游描述了他们在星期五爆发时被夹住的令人痛心的时刻,他所在的人群中有3人丧生.

items.title: South African president says he will not step down after impeachment call
items.title_zh: 南非总统说他不会在弹劾后下台
items.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says he will legally challenge a report that has paved the way for parliament to consider impeachment proceedings against him over the theft of large sums of cash from his private farm.
items.summary_zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨(Cyril Ramaphosa)表示,他将依法质疑一份报告,该报告为议会审议弹劾他从私人农场偷取一大笔现金的诉讼铺平了道路。

items.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
items.title_zh: 欧盟同意对西岸暴力的以色列定居者实施制裁
items.summary: The twenty-seven foreign ministers of the European Union approved new sanctions on Monday on Israeli settlers over rising violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲联盟27名外交部长星期一批准了对以色列定居者对被占领西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力上升的新制裁。

items.title: Portrait looted by Nazis found in home of Dutch SS leader's descendants
items.title_zh: 纳粹在荷兰党卫军领袖后裔的家中 洗劫了肖像
items.summary: A painting stolen by Nazis from a Jewish art collector in the Netherlands during World War Two has been found in the home of descendants of a notorious Dutch SS collaborator, an art detective says.
items.summary_zh: 二战期间被纳粹从荷兰一位犹太艺术收藏家所盗取的一幅画被发现于臭名昭著的荷兰党卫军合作者的后人家中,一位艺术侦探说.

items.title: 'Britain at the heart of Europe': How Starmer's plans are going down in the EU
items.title_zh: '欧洲之心的Britain':斯塔默的计划如何在欧盟下行.
items.summary: "A UK prime minister, using the idea of getting closer to the European Union as a political life vest to get the British public on his side? That is certainly not something we in the EU would have predicted. Especially when you think - it's the 10-year anniversary of the Brexit vote next month!"
items.summary_zh: "一位英国首相,利用越走越近欧盟的想法,当做政治救生衣来让英国公众支持他? 这肯定不是我们欧盟人预料到的。 尤其是你认为——下个月是布雷克西特投票十周年!".

items.title: 'Total lack of respect': Macron interrupts speaker to ask for silence
items.title_zh: "完全没有尊重": Macron打断了演讲者请求沉默

items.summary_zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在内罗毕非洲前进首脑会议上打断了一名台上发言者,要求听众保持安静。

items.title: Watch: Soldier on parachuting to remote island to bring Hantavirus aid

items.title: Trump's China visit set to test fragile truce

items.summary_zh: 北京证实美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周将赴中国会见习近平.

items.title: BBC tests out England and Argentina's World Cup training grounds in Kansas City
items.title_zh: BBC在堪萨斯城对英格兰和阿根廷世界杯训练场的测试
items.summary: The BBC's Will Grant has been taking a look around the base camps that England and defending champions Argentina will call home during the FIFA World Cup.
items.summary_zh: BBC的"威尔·格兰特"一直在环绕英国和卫冕冠军阿根廷在国际足联世界杯期间将召回的基地阵营进行考察.

items.title: Why Eurovision's fallout over Israel may change the competition forever
items.title_zh: 为什么Eurovision对以色列的影响 可能永远改变竞争
items.summary: Moments after Austria overtook Israel to win last May's Eurovision Song Contest and in doing so won the right to host this year's event, UK viewers heard commentator Graham Norton say organisers "will be breathing the largest sigh of relief that they're not faced with a Tel Aviv final next year".
items.summary_zh: 在奥地利超越以色列赢得去年5月的欧洲视觉歌曲大赛之后,

items.title: BBC speaks with civilians inside Iran struggling with impact of war
items.title_zh: BBC 与伊朗国内的平民交谈,
items.summary: Inside Iran, the BBC has been speaking to people struggling with the impact of the war.
items.summary_zh: 在伊朗境内,英国广播公司一直向那些为战争所影响而挣扎的人们讲话.

items.title: Tourist hotspot at 'end of the world' denies causing hantavirus outbreak
items.title_zh: "世界末日"的旅游热点 否认引起汉塔病毒爆发
items.summary: As Argentina's southernmost city, Ushuaia has long enjoyed its reputation as 'The End of the World' and as a gateway for trips both to Antarctica and for tourists to explore the dramatic, natural beauty of Patagonia.
items.summary_zh: 作为阿根廷最南端的城市,乌斯怀亚长期享有"世界末日"的名声并成为前往南极洲和游客探索巴塔哥尼亚戏剧性自然美景的出道口.

items.summary_zh: 度假者告诉英国广播公司一些旅馆和度假胜地如何用毛巾对保留日光休息室的人进行打压,

items.title: How could extreme weather affect World Cup 2026?
items.title_zh: 极端天气如何会影响2026年世界杯?.
items.summary: With just a month to go until the biggest football tournament in the world begins, attention is turning not just to the teams and venues, but to the weather.
items.summary_zh: 距离世界最大足球锦标赛开始还有一个月的时间, 注意力不仅转向球队和场地, 也转向天气。

items.title: Indian model's understated Met Gala debut revives debate on cultural representation

items.title: Another year, another controversy for Eurovision - but fans are sticking by it

items.summary_zh: 2026年欧视歌曲大赛于周日在维也纳正式落地,由来自所有35个国家的竞争者主演的"绿地地毯"游行.

items.title: Why Canada is seeing its biggest military recruitment surge in 30 years
items.title_zh: 为何加拿大30年来最大的征兵人数激增?
items.summary: For decades, Canada was seen as a global laggard in defence funding, and just two years ago, recruitment was so dire that a former defence minister warned the armed forces were in a "death spiral".
items.summary_zh: 几十年来,加拿大一直被视为全球国防资金的落后者,而就在两年前,征兵情况十分严峻,以至于一位前国防部长警告了武装部队处于"死亡螺旋".

items.title: Steve Rosenberg: This year's Victory Day parade in Moscow felt very different
